_meta.description: SSR reference statement sets for mapping free-text responses to Likert distributions
_meta.question_text: How likely would you be to purchase this product?

design_constraints.notes: Each set captures a different natural framing of purchase intent. Sets are averaged to reduce sensitivity to any single phrasing.

anchors.1: It's very unlikely I'd buy this.
anchors.3: I'm not sure whether I'd buy this or not.

anchors.1: This isn't something I would purchase.
anchors.2: I don't think I'd purchase this.
anchors.3: I might or might not purchase this.
anchors.4: I think I would purchase this.
anchors.5: I'm quite confident I would purchase this.

anchors.1: I'm not interested in this product.
anchors.2: I don't think this product is for me.
anchors.3: I'm not sure if I'd be interested in this.
anchors.4: This product seems interesting to me.
anchors.5: I'm very interested in getting this product.

anchors.1: I wouldn't spend my money on this.
anchors.2: I don't think this is worth buying.
anchors.3: I'd have to think about whether it's worth the money.
anchors.4: I'd consider spending money on this.
anchors.5: I'd happily pay for this product.

anchors.3: I might give this a try, I'm not sure.
anchors.4: I'd probably give this a try.
anchors.5: I'd definitely want to try this.

anchors.1: This product doesn't fit my needs at all.
anchors.2: I don't think I need something like this.
anchors.3: This could be useful, but I'm on the fence.
anchors.4: I think this product would work well for me.
anchors.5: This is exactly what I've been looking for.
